parts.instruction: You will hear three different extracts. For questions 1-6, choose the answer (A, B or C) which fits best

questions.prompt: They disagree about whether the woman’s flight

options.label: offered good value for money.
managed to arrive on time.
provided reasonable comfort level.

questions.prompt: What is the man’s advice for the woman?

options.label: trying a different air company
choosing a different destination airport
changing the means of transport

questions.prompt: What is her opinion of pupils using the Internet to find new information?

options.label: It has altered the teacher’s role in the studying process
It has to be supervised by a teacher
It can’t substitute a teacher figure in the classroom

questions.prompt: What is her opinion of her approach to teaching?

options.label: She is ready change it to better suit student’s needs
She regrets her colleagues not using the same techniques
She is certain that it has positive results

questions.prompt: What impressed the woman most about the new album?

options.label: the way it was recorded
the style of the recording
the variety of instruments used

questions.prompt: According to the man, what makes the band stand out?

options.label: the originality of their sound
the high quality of tracks
the organic combination of various music styles

parts.instruction: You will hear a student called Jon talking about llama, an animal that comes from South America.. For questions 7-14, complete the sentences.

questions.prompt: Jon says that you can tell llamas and alpacas apart by the shape of their ________.
Jon discovered that the wild ancestor of the llama was mostly ________ in colour.
In ancient times, domesticated llamas could often be found working in ________ areas.
Jon says that the word ________ is most commonly used to describe llamas.
Jon found out that llamas that are trained properly would only kick and spit when they feel ________.
Jon describes the noise llamas use to communicate as a ________.
Jon says that llama fleece is popular with weavers because it doesn’t contain any ________.
The most common goods made from llama hair are ________.

parts.instruction: You will hear an interview with a young film director, Lauren, talking about her life and work.. For questions 15-20, choose the answer (A, B, C or D) which fits best according to what you hear.

questions.prompt: Lauren was prompted by her teachers to to pursue a film-making career because they

options.label: believed that she had potential.
found her early attempts highly original.
were impressed by how motivated she was.
appreciated her ability to work within a budget.

questions.prompt: What is Lauren’s opinion of criticism towards film schools?

options.label: She believes that such critics would benefit from joining it.
She defends the record of the one that she attended.
She agrees that it’s less useful for certain types of work.
She regrets that it’s the only option for poorer students.

questions.prompt: Lauren didn’t shoot a full-length film sooner because

options.label: she wanted to be sure of her ability first.
she was previously unsuccessful with them.
she didn’t get any offers from studios.
she couldn’t find financial support for it.

questions.prompt: What does Lauren say about the characters in her films?

options.label: She tries to surprise her audience with them.
She likes them to fit into well-defined types.
She accepts that the men may be more interesting.
She sets out to make them as complicated as possible.

questions.prompt: How does Lauren feel now about the film Hidden Valley Dreams?

options.label: She regrets the setting she chose for it.
She regards it as being far from perfect.
She’s surprised that it’s proved so popular.
She wishes she’d spent more time on the plot.

questions.prompt: How does Lauren feel about giving talks at schools?

options.label: unsure whether to reveal her humble background
concerned that she might give the kids unrealistic ambitions
slightly uncomfortable with the idea of being a role model
worried that she may not command the respect of the students
